overview.description: The Xtrackers Municipal Infrastructure Revenue Bond Active ETF (RVNU) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in broad credit fixed income. The fund is an actively managed US fixed income ETF that seeks federal tax-exempt income by investing in municipal infrastructure revenue bonds. The ETF may invest across a range of credit qualities and maturities, with a dollar-weighted average effective maturity generally targeted between five and ten years. RVNU was launched on Jun 4, 2013 and is issued by Xtrackers.
